final_message: Parsed `workspace/app.log`, extracted all entries whose level is ERROR or CRITICAL (case‑insensitive), converted timestamps to UTC, captured the message, last traceback line (or null), and summed repeat counts from “-- last message repeated N times --” lines. Produced `workspace/errors.json` with an `errors` array and `counts_by_service` totals (inventory‑service 13, auth‑service 8, payment‑service 8).

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".
